listing.name: Rocket: Robot on Wheels (Rocket-R)
listing.summary: Explore Rocket: Robot on Wheels (Rocket-R) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Select your own Rocket ROM on first Play
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose your own supported Rocket: Robot on Wheels US ROM in the upstream launcher. It verifies the game and remembers the chosen path. Use the upstream menus for controls and compatible mods; no game compilation or separate installer is needed for the published player.

steps.title: Keep saves and mod profiles separately backed up
steps.instruction: Default Windows saves, settings, mod profiles, mod-specific saves, logs and crash reports use %APPDATA%/Rocket-R. Keep a separate backup of the actual profile before changing versions; older versions may not read newer saves. Its external profile is outside Portcove backup and runtime rollback; rollback does not rewind saves. Keep each release’s own bundled engine/mod resources together, and keep custom --config or developer paths backed up separately.

steps.title: Linux uses its own upstream launcher
steps.instruction: Choose the Linux x86-64 AppImage, or extract the Linux Portable archive and deliberately run Launch-Rocket-R.sh when ordinary AppImage launch is unavailable. The tar.gz contains an AppImage and wrapper, not a bare native player. Steam Deck uses the separate x86-64 SteamDeck archive and START-ROCKET-R.sh; ARM64 packages are different choices. Follow the upstream Linux profile and update instructions and preserve the current copy. Portcove’s managed Windows route does not manage this wrapper.

steps.title: Android keeps its own private copy
steps.instruction: Use the separate Android ARM64 APK on the Android device, open Rocket-R and select your own matching US ROM. The app keeps a private ROM copy; preserve its actual app saves and settings before updating, clearing storage or uninstalling. Its update and data handling stay with Android/upstream. Desktop archive inspection does not qualify Android execution or every device.
